searchText: > it is an error for a given subcontainer to be referenced by both `RETURNCONTRACT` and `EOFCREATE` Does this mean a subcontainer can only be referenced by one kind or only by one operation? Is this one operation per code section or one operation overall? One kind. It only matters if the container only reverts anyway. That is the only legal way to have both kinds reference one container. There is a test for this So we need to store per subcontainer by which method is was called? Only during validation. But yes, which opcode calls the subcontainer.
